properties.site-address: Ashington Fire Station, Morpeth Road, Ashington
properties.notes: Former fire station site and associated land, which has been sold for redevelopment and offers an infill opportunity. A recent application has been approved for a mixed-use scheme. Despite this, it is considered that longer-term potential for residential development could still remain in the future. The extant planning permission includes consent for B2 mixed-use and to extend existing use of premises to include car sales (17/01879/FUL).
